articles.title: Dentists issue warnings about pop-up consultations in hotels
articles.summary: Premises in which dentistry happens must be registered with the relevant inspectorate but most hotels are not.
articles.body:
A dentist says he is "deeply concerned" by illegal dental tourism pop-up consultations in Northern Irish hotels, which are not properly registered.

Paul Brennan, chair of the Northern Ireland branch of the British Dental Association (BDA), said patients' mouths were often examined at these events, which constitutes the "practice of dentistry".

The BDA has warned that when dentistry occurs and the hotels and dentists are not registered with their regulators, it can amount to "illegal practice".

The Northern Ireland Hotels Federation (NIHF) said it had shared the BDA's guidance with its members.

Anyone practising dentistry in the UK must be registered with the General Dental Council (GDC) and any venue in which it occurs must be registered with Regulation and Quality Improvement Authority (RQIA).

RQIA said it had received intelligence about 21 "unregistered entities" that have organised consultation events since October 2023.

It said "where concerns have arisen regarding the provision or promotion of dental tourism treatments in Northern Ireland", cease and desist letters had been sent to "the overseas dental practice involved" rather than the venue hosting the event.

Two upcoming events in Belfast have been cancelled either by the overseas provider or the hotel, following enquiries by BBC News NI.

Brennan said an "increasing" number of events at which the rules were not being followed were occurring, mainly in Londonderry and Belfast.

He said hoteliers were often "not aware" that "what's happening in their hotels actually constitutes dentistry" and is therefore illegal.

"We had a positive engagement with the Hotels Federation," he said.

"They're interested in protecting their members. They obviously don't want illegal activity to be occurring in their members' hotels."

Leonardo Hotel in Belfast, which has cancelled one of its upcoming events, said the booking had "initially met our requirements based on the information provided".

"Following further assessment and consideration, we have decided to cancel. Our team ensures that meeting spaces are only used for their intended purpose," it added.

Cancellation 'not an admission' of unlawfulness

One overseas provider, Smiles Turkey, said it had cancelled a separate event in Belfast after "concerns were expressed about its legality".

It said there had been a "misunderstanding" and it had intended to provide "a non-clinical commercial and information event".

"Our sales representatives were not going to conduct physical or intra-oral examinations of patients' mouths, teeth or gums. Cancellation should not be interpreted as an admission that the event was unlawful," it added.

The Ramada Hotel, where the pop-up was to take place, was approached for comment.

However, the BDA says pop-up consultations often go "beyond merely the marketing of overseas dental services".

Brennan, who is a dentist in Strabane, said he had attended one such event and had his teeth examined.

"Once you examine a patient's mouth, that's dentistry," he explained.

"You don't have to do anything on them apart from an examination. Someone looking in your mouth and telling you, I think you need x, y and z, is dentistry."

He also said many of the dentists doing the examinations were often "coming from abroad" and were not registered in the UK.

"They may be registered in their own countries, but they're often not registered here, so they're actually carrying out dentistry illegally", Brennan explained.

The BDA also said more patients in Northern Ireland were presenting with "serious dental complications" after having received dental treatment overseas.

"This has typically followed an initial dental consultation advertised and held in a Northern Ireland venue."

The BDA also said the regulatory regime in Northern Ireland was "falling short" because of RQIA's "inability to regulate certain premises where the practice of dentistry is being carried out".

The Department of Health said RQIA might gather intelligence regarding dental pop-up clinics but it does not have legislative powers to prosecute. These powers rest with the General Dental Council.

A spokesperson said RQIA may "write to the organiser to advise them that holding a dental consultation in Northern Ireland may be considered to be the provision of private dental care and treatment.

"The organiser is advised that such services are required under the legislation to register with RQIA, and that providing them, without being registered with RQIA, is an offence," they added.

The GDC said it had also "sent out cease and desist letters to a number of companies in Northern Ireland" and had written to "a number of hotels to make them aware of their responsibilities under the law".

It added that this is "a precautionary step, not enforcement action, and doesn't suggest any wrongdoing on the part of the venues themselves".

articles.title: Seleção da Prefeitura de Montes Claros: Inscrições terminam hoje | G1
articles.standfirst: Vagas temporárias são para os cargos de coveiros e educadores cuidadores. Seleção será realizada por meio da análise da escolaridade e da experiência profissional dos inscritos.
articles.summary: Vagas temporárias são para os cargos de coveiros e educadores cuidadores. Seleção será realizada por meio da análise da escolaridade e da experiência profissional dos inscritos.
articles.body:
Nova Prefeitura de Montes Claros — Foto: Fábio Marçal/Prefeitura de Montes Claros

Terminam nesta segunda-feira (14) as inscrições para um processo seletivo da Prefeitura de Montes Claros destinado à contratação temporária de coveiros e educadores cuidadores. Ao todo, são oferecidas 42 vagas imediatas, além de cadastro de reserva.

Para a função de coveiro, estão disponíveis 12 vagas, além da formação de cadastro de reserva. A jornada de trabalho é de 40 horas semanais, com remuneração de R$ 1.622,42 por mês. Os candidatos devem ter ensino fundamental completo. A experiência profissional como ajudante de serviços gerais será considerada para fins de classificação.

Para o cargo de educador cuidador, são ofertadas 30 vagas, também com cadastro de reserva. A carga horária é de 40 horas semanais e o salário mensal é de R$ 1.853,51. A escolaridade mínima exigida é o ensino médio. Experiência em acolhimento institucional e em serviços socioassistenciais também será considerada na classificação dos candidatos.

A seleção será realizada por meio da análise da escolaridade e da experiência profissional dos inscritos. A comprovação da experiência deverá ser feita por meio de carteira de trabalho, contratos ou declarações.

As inscrições podem ser realizadas pelo portal da Prefeitura de Montes Claros, na aba “Central de Concursos”.

articles.title: Estacionamento na Avenida Sílvio Teixeira é proibido em Aracaju | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida nos dois sentidos da via no Bairro Grageru busca garantir a fluidez do trânsito durante e após obras em canal, de acordo com a SMTT.
articles.summary: A SMTT Aracaju proibiu o estacionamento na Avenida Sílvio Teixeira, no Bairro Grageru, para melhorar a fluidez do trânsito durante e após obras no canal local.
articles.body:
Proibição de estacionamento na Avenida Sílvio Teixeira, em Aracaju. — Foto: SMTT

A proibição de estacionamento na Avenida Sílvio Teixeira, no Bairro Grageru, em Aracaju, passa a valer de forma definitiva a partir desta segunda-feira (14). A restrição é aplicada nos dois sentidos da via, que recebeu nova sinalização vertical, de acordo com a Superintendência de Transporte e Trânsito (SMTT).

A mudança ocorre no mesmo período em que a Empresa Municipal de Obras e Urbanização (Emurb) realiza uma obra no canal localizado no trecho. Durante a execução do serviço, a pista fica reduzida temporariamente para uma faixa de circulação. A previsão é que a obra dure cerca de uma semana.

De acordo com a SMTT, a proibição de estacionamento também tem o objetivo de evitar o estreitamento da pista no cotidiano, situação que gerava retenções, principalmente nos horários de pico.

Durante a realização dos serviços, os motoristas podem utilizar como rotas alternativas as avenidas Francisco Porto e Marieta Leite.

articles.title: Sine Piauí abre 248 vagas de emprego em Teresina e Floriano | G1
articles.standfirst: Oportunidades estão distribuídas entre Teresina e Floriano, incluindo postos exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.
articles.summary: O Sine Piauí disponibiliza 248 vagas de emprego em Teresina e Floriano nesta segunda-feira, incluindo oportunidades exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência em diversas áreas.
articles.body:
O Sistema Nacional de Emprego (SINE Piauí) oferece 248 vagas de emprego no Piauí nesta segunda-feira (14). As oportunidades destinam-se a candidatos com diferentes níveis de escolaridade e experiência. As vagas disponíveis estão distribuídas entre os municípios de Teresina e Floriano .

Das 248 vagas ofertadas, 181 estão localizadas em Teresina, sendo 124 para ampla concorrência e 57 exclusivas para Pessoas com Deficiência. O município de Floriano concentra 67 oportunidades.

Em Teresina, as 124 vagas de ampla concorrência contemplam diferentes áreas de atuação e níveis de qualificação.

Os cargos com maior oferta de oportunidades são técnico em fibras ópticas, com 17 vagas, e auxiliar de cozinha, que soma 19 vagas no total. Para técnico em fibras ópticas, exige-se ensino médio completo, veículo próprio, Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) categoria B e seis meses de experiência. Para auxiliar de cozinha, há 17 vagas.

Há ainda 15 vagas para promotor de vendas na modalidade Jovem Aprendiz. O cargo de atendente de mesa soma 11 vagas.

O cargo de atendente de balcão disponibiliza 6 vagas. Também são oferecidas cinco vagas para auxiliar técnico de montagem (auxiliar de fibra óptica).

O cargo de empregado doméstico nos serviços gerais conta com uma vaga destinada a quem possa dormir no local de trabalho e atuar como cuidador de idosos. Para vendedor pracista, há duas oportunidades.

O SINE disponibiliza duas vagas para cada um dos seguintes cargos: auxiliar de limpeza, bombeiro hidráulico, eletricista, encarregado de obras, jardineiro e oficial de manutenção predial. Além disso, há uma vaga para auxiliar de escritório, caseiro, confeiteiro, marceneiro, motorista de ambulância, pintor de obras, pizzaiolo e supervisor administrativo.

O Posto Central do Sine oferece 57 vagas exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência em Teresina. Entre os destaques estão:

Operador de teleatendimento ativo lidera a lista, com 20 vagas. O cargo exige ensino médio completo e conhecimentos básicos de informática, mas não requer experiência. Outras funções com alta demanda são atendente de farmácia e auxiliar de estoque, com 10 oportunidades cada.

Também há vagas para ajudante de motorista (2), auxiliar de manutenção predial (2), manobrista (2), motorista entregador (2) e operador de empilhadeira (2).

As demais oportunidades contemplam os cargos de agente operacional de estação, atendente comercial, auxiliar de escritório, mecânico de manutenção de automóveis, operador de caixa, recepcionista atendente e vendedor interno, com uma vaga cada.

Em Floriano, estão disponíveis 67 vagas. Todas exigem ensino médio completo e não requerem experiência.

As maiores ofertas são para auxiliar de limpeza (15 vagas), vendedor no comércio de mercadorias (10 vagas), operador de caixa (9 vagas), repositor de mercadorias (5 vagas) e vendedor interno (5 vagas). Também há oportunidades para ajudante de obras (4 vagas) e recepcionista secretária (3 vagas).

O município disponibiliza duas vagas para cada um dos seguintes cargos: auxiliar administrativo, churrasqueiro, cozinheiro de restaurante, forneiro de padaria, frentista, oficial de serviços gerais na manutenção de edificações, recepcionista de hotel e vendedor pracista.

Para concorrer às vagas, os candidatos devem estar cadastrados no banco de dados do Sine. Em Teresina, o atendimento presencial ocorre de segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h às 13h, nos postos do Centro, Dirceu e Espaço Cidadania.

O agendamento para atendimento presencial na capital deve ser feito previamente pelo site do órgão .

Para realizar o cadastro, o trabalhador deve apresentar:

Carteira de Trabalho e Previdência Social (CTPS), física ou digital;

Carteira de Identidade (RG) e Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF);

Cartão ou número do Programa de Integração Social (PIS) ou Programa de Formação do Patrimônio do Servidor Público (Pasep);

Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH), para vagas que exijam condução de veículos;

Certificados de qualificação profissional, caso possua.

Todos os serviços oferecidos pelo Sine são gratuitos. O órgão informa que as vagas podem ser preenchidas ao longo do dia e, por isso, a disponibilidade dos cargos pode mudar sem aviso prévio.

articles.title: Terceira morte ligada ao sarampo é registrada na Pensilvânia em 2026 | G1
articles.standfirst: Mulher de 40 anos morreu após complicações associadas à doença. Estado já contabiliza 676 casos e 124 hospitalizações neste ano.
articles.summary: Mulher de 40 anos morreu após complicações associadas à doença. Estado já contabiliza 676 casos e 124 hospitalizações neste ano.
articles.body:
Imagem de microscopia eletrônica de uma partícula do vírus do sarampo. — Foto: Cynthia Goldsmith/Centros de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças, via AP, Arquivo

Uma mulher de 40 anos morreu após complicações associadas ao sarampo na Pensilvânia, nos Estados Unidos. É a terceira morte relacionada à doença registrada no estado em 2026.

A morte ocorreu no sábado (12), segundo o legista do condado de Jefferson, Greg Furlong. A vítima morava na região, uma área rural localizada a cerca de 80 quilômetros de Pittsburgh.

As autoridades não divulgaram a identidade da mulher nem informaram se ela havia sido vacinada contra o sarampo.

A Pensilvânia enfrenta um aumento expressivo de casos da doença. Até sexta-feira (11), o estado havia registrado 676 casos de sarampo em 37 dos 67 condados, segundo o Departamento de Saúde estadual.

Do total, 124 pacientes precisaram ser hospitalizados. Apenas quatro dos casos registrados ocorreram em pessoas vacinadas contra o sarampo.

As outras duas mortes relacionadas ao sarampo registradas na Pensilvânia neste ano ocorreram em agosto e envolveram bebês.

Uma menina de seis semanas morreu em decorrência da doença, segundo autoridades locais. Ela havia nascido com uma condição genética rara que provocava alterações graves no desenvolvimento do cérebro e aumentava sua vulnerabilidade a infecções.

Outro bebê, um menino, morreu pouco depois do nascimento devido à ruptura do baço. Ele também estava infectado pelo vírus do sarampo, mas, segundo o legista do condado de Lancaster, a infecção não foi considerada responsável pela ruptura. O sarampo apareceu no registro como uma condição relevante presente no momento da morte.

Nenhum dos dois bebês tinha idade para receber a primeira dose da vacina contra o sarampo, aplicada normalmente por volta de 1 ano de vida nos Estados Unidos.

Dados estaduais divergem dos registros do CDC

Apesar das três mortes relatadas por autoridades da Pensilvânia, os registros nacionais dos Centros de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças dos Estados Unidos (CDC) ainda não contabilizavam, até domingo (13), mortes por sarampo no país em 2026.

Segundo o CDC, o Centro Nacional de Estatísticas de Saúde ainda não tinha registros de óbitos neste ano em que o sarampo aparecesse como causa básica da morte.

A diferença ocorre porque os registros locais podem ser divulgados antes da consolidação das informações nos bancos nacionais de mortalidade.

As mortes anteriores também provocaram divergências públicas entre o governo da Pensilvânia, comandado pelo democrata Josh Shapiro, e a gestão do presidente Donald Trump sobre a classificação dos óbitos relacionados ao sarampo.

articles.body:
29 apostas do interior de Pernambuco acertaram a números no concurso 3057 da Mega-Sena . O sorteio foi realizado na noite do domingo (13), em São Paulo. Nenhuma aposta do Brasil acertou as seis dezenas e o prêmio principal acumulou em R$ 95 milhões para o próximo sorteio.

Os números sorteados foram: 02 - 04 - 16 - 21 - 48 - 53

Os apostadores que acertaram a quadra, no interior de Pernambuco, são do Agreste, Sertão e Zona da Mata Sul. Todos levaram o prêmio de R$ 863,24.

Confira apostas vencedoras do concurso 3057 da Mega-Sena

O g1 passou a transmitir, desde abril, todos os sorteios das Loterias Caixa, ao vivo. A transmissão começa momentos antes de cada dia de concursos, no site e no canal do g1 no YouTube .

Mega-Sena, concurso 3057 — Foto: Reprodução

A aposta mínima custa R$ 6 e pode ser realizada também pela internet, até as 20h – saiba como fazer a sua aposta online .

Os jogos podem ser realizados até as 20h (horário de Brasília) em qualquer lotérica do país ou por meio do site e aplicativo Loterias Caixa, disponíveis em smartphones, computadores e outros dispositivos.

Já os bolões digitais poderão ser comprados até as 20h30, exclusivamente pelo portal Loterias Online e pelo aplicativo.

O pagamento da aposta online pode ser realizado via PIX, cartão de crédito ou pelo internet banking, para correntistas da Caixa. É preciso ter 18 anos ou mais para participar.

A Mega tem três sorteios semanais: às terças, quintas e domingos.

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.summary: O alerta de baixa umidade na Paraíba prevê índices entre 20% e 30%, com recomendações do Inmet para evitar problemas de saúde e riscos de incêndios florestais.
articles.body:
Inmet emite alerta de baixa umidade para mais de 110 cidades da Paraíba; veja a lista — Foto: Reprodução / TV Cabo Branco

O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (Inmet) emitiu, nesta segunda-feira (14), um alerta amarelo de baixa umidade do ar que afeta cidades da Paraíba. O aviso que vale para 114 municípios. Veja abaixo lista de municípios afetados.

O período de aviso começa às 10 desta segunda-feira (14) e segue vigente até às 22h do mesmo dia. Um alerta havia sido emitido no domingo (13) para 68 cidades, sendo ampliado depois.

Durante o período do alerta, a umidade relativa do ar deve variar entre 30% e 20%, índices considerados abaixo do recomendado para a saúde.

Segundo o Inmet, há baixo risco de incêndios florestais e de impactos à saúde, mas a população deve adotar medidas de prevenção para reduzir os efeitos do tempo seco.

articles.title: Máquina de algodão doce: a resistência é a peça que mais falha | G1
articles.standfirst: Quem trabalha com algodão doce sabe que a resistência queima. Veja como identificar a peça certa e o que checar antes de comprar a reposição
articles.summary: Quem trabalha com algodão doce sabe que a resistência queima. Veja como identificar a peça certa e o que checar antes de comprar a reposição
articles.body:
Quem vive de festa, evento ou ponto ambulante conhece a rotina: a máquina de algodão doce para de funcionar sempre pelo mesmo motivo — a resistência queimou . Não é defeito de fabricação, é desgaste natural da peça que trabalha no calor extremo. O que separa o prejuízo do contratempo é ter a reposição certa.

Resistências elétricas e bacias em alumínio para máquina de algodão doce — Foto: Divulgação / Panela de Ferro Fundido

A resistência derrete o açúcar dentro do cabeçote giratório, trabalhando em ciclos de aquecimento rápido e alta rotação. Além do estresse térmico, ela sofre com resíduo de açúcar caramelizado, que se acumula e altera a dissipação de calor. Máquina mal limpa queima resistência muito antes.

Resíduo de açúcar caramelizado altera a dissipação de calor: máquina mal limpa queima resistência antes.

O que checar antes de comprar a reposição

1.Diâmetro do cabeçote — as peças costumam ser de 11 cm ou 13 cm; medir é obrigatório.

2. T ensão — 110 V ou 220 V; comprar errado queima na primeira ligação.

3. M odelo da máquina — o encaixe varia entre fabricantes.

4. Tenha u ma reserva em estoque: a peça falha em evento, não em casa.

5. A troca envolve parte elétrica; se você não tem prática, encaminhe a um técnico.

A bacia amassa e risca com o transporte, e bacia amassada gira o algodão de forma irregular. Em alumínio laminado, ela é leve e resistente à limpeza frequente. Trocar a bacia às vezes resolve um problema que se atribui à máquina. As peças para máquina de algodão doce incluem resistências e bacias.

Sediada em Divinópolis , no Centro-Oeste de Minas, a Panela de Ferro Fundido trabalha com peças e acessórios para máquinas de doces. Os modelos estão no catálogo de máquinas de doces e acessórios , com entrega para todo o Brasil.

articles.title: Construção a seco ganha espaço em Goiás e transforma forma de construir | G1
articles.standfirst: Plack Sistemas Construtivos é um dos exemplos da popularização desse tipo de construção em Goiás
articles.summary: Plack Sistemas Construtivos é um dos exemplos da popularização desse tipo de construção em Goiás
articles.body:
Obras mais rápidas, limpas e sustentáveis já são realidade graças a um modelo construtivo que, durante muitos anos, foi visto como uma alternativa no Brasil: a construção a seco. O sistema, adotado em países como o Reino Unido e os Estados Unidos, tem ganhado espaço nos canteiros de obras de Goiás e transformado a construção civil no estado. O sistema não depende de água para a montagem e, ao eliminar o tempo de cura de argamassas, é capaz de agilizar as obras. Em um cenário cada vez mais voltado à sustentabilidade, alternativas como o Steel Frame e o Drywall também têm se destacado pela eficiência e inovação.

Plack, líder em construção a seco em Goiás — Foto: Acervo

O Steel Frame é um sistema construtivo leve e industrializado, baseado em perfis de aço galvanizado que compõem a estrutura de paredes, lajes e coberturas. Diferentemente da alvenaria tradicional, ele permite a montagem de edificações de forma mais rápida, limpa e precisa, com menor geração de resíduos e maior controle de qualidade. Já o Drywall é composto por placas de gesso pré-fabricadas, fixadas às estruturas de aço galvanizado no fechamento interno de casas e edifícios. Na comparação com a alvenaria convencional de tijolos, o sistema confere leveza à estrutura, melhora o isolamento termoacústico e reduz os custos de acabamento.

Com a crescente procura pela tecnologia, o mercado vem se estruturando para atender aos profissionais que optam por métodos industrializados. No cenário goiano, a Plack Sistemas Construtivos é considerada uma das precursoras na expansão desse modelo. Há mais de 13 anos no mercado, a empresa atua com Drywall, Steel Frame e pisos vinílicos, fornecendo os insumos necessários com perfis metálicos e chapas de alta tecnologia. Atualmente, a empresa conta com um Centro de Distribuição com mais de 5 mil produtos, dos quais mais de 2 mil estão disponíveis a pronta-entrega.

Centro de Distribuição da Plack com mais de 5 Mil produtos — Foto: Acervo

Outro destaque da distribuidora é a capacidade logística: são 4.580 metros quadrados de área de armazenagem, apontada como o maior centro de estoque do segmento no estado, com capacidade para suprir desde reformas pontuais até grandes canteiros de construtoras e incorporadoras parceiras. Para o fundador e diretor da Plack, Jones Chiarello, a construção a seco já faz parte da rotina dos canteiros, mas a consolidação da tendência no estado depende da pronta disponibilidade de insumos. Com foco na agilidade de atendimento, segundo ele, a empresa estruturou um fluxo de remessa rápida. “Em pedidos de até duas toneladas realizados até as 14h em Goiânia ou Aparecida de Goiânia, o material é entregue no mesmo dia. O crescimento da Plack acima do mercado vem da capacidade de oferecer soluções completas. Variedade, disponibilidade, entrega rápida, conhecimento técnico e treinamentos que ajudam a formar mão de obra para o setor” , aponta.

Diante da necessidade de obras mais rápidas, limpas e previsíveis, o uso de sistemas industrializados cresce cerca de 12% ao ano, de acordo com levantamento da Associação Brasileira de Drywall. A adoção do sistema faz sentido em um estado como Goiás, que alcançou R$ 15,9 bilhões em valor de incorporações, obras e serviços da construção civil em 2024, conforme dados da Pesquisa Anual da Indústria da Construção (Paic). O desempenho colocou o estado na liderança do Centro-Oeste e na nona posição entre as unidades federativas brasileiras.

A Plack conta com uma frota própria de mais de 25 caminhões para chegar em todos os Estados do país — Foto: Acervo

Embora a agilidade seja um forte atrativo, Chiarello ressalta que o rigor técnico é o elemento decisivo para a sustentação desse mercado em Goiás. “A qualidade é um pilar importante. Na Plack, nós trabalhamos com marcas líderes e produtos normatizados e, ao mesmo tempo, investimos fortemente em tecnologia, gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Tudo isso para tornar nossos processos mais eficientes, fortalecer nossa equipe e garantir uma experiência cada vez melhor para o cliente” , garante o fundador.

articles.title: Cobranças armadas: entenda operação que prendeu foragida do DF no TO | G1
articles.standfirst: Polícia aponta que grupo atuava em três estados, cobrava juros de até 20% ao mês e usava intimidações para recuperar valores.
articles.summary: Polícia aponta que grupo atuava em três estados, cobrava juros de até 20% ao mês e usava intimidações para recuperar valores.
articles.body:
Uma operação que investiga um esquema interestadual de agiotagem, extorsão e lavagem de dinheiro levou à prisão de uma jovem de 22 anos em Lagoa da Confusão , no oeste do Tocantins. Segundo a investigação, a suspeita identificada como Maria Luiza integrava uma organização criminosa que atuava no Distrito Federal, em Goiás e no Tocantins.

Segundo a polícia, a organização movimentou cerca de R$ 10 milhões em apenas oito meses. Para ocultar a origem dos valores, os investigados utilizavam contas bancárias de pessoas jurídicas e de parentes. O grupo concedia empréstimos com juros de até 20% ao mês e utilizava ameaças para cobrar os valores devidos.

📱 Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 TO no WhatsApp

A prisão ocorreu neste domingo (13). Ao todo, a Justiça do Distrito Federal (DF) expediu 47 ordens judiciais — sendo 12 prisões preventivas, 18 mandados de busca e apreensão e 17 bloqueios financeiros.

O g1 não conseguiu contato com a defesa de Maria Luiza até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Maria Luiza, de 22 anos, é suspeita de integrar uma quadrilha interestadual de agiotagem e extorsão — Foto: Reprodução

A apuração teve início após um comerciante da Feira dos Goianos, em Taguatinga (DF), denunciar à polícia que vinha sendo ameaçado junto com familiares após pegar dinheiro emprestado e não conseguir quitar a dívida em razão das taxas abusivas.

A decisão judicial que determinou a prisão aponta que Maria Luiza apareceu em imagens de câmeras de segurança no prédio de uma das vítimas e utilizava uma linha telefônica para realizar cobranças com ameaças.

Os investigadores reuniram mensagens, planilhas e áudios que reforçam a ligação da suspeita com os demais integrantes da organização.

O processo revela ainda que uma das vítimas sofreu ameaças diretas. Após a prisão de outros membros do grupo, a suspeita foi até a casa dessa pessoa com um homem armado e exigiu uma cópia do depoimento.

Em áudios obtidos pela investigação, criminosos ameaçavam os devedores de morte caso não pagassem as dívidas. Nas diligências, foram apreendidos 10 armas de fogo, grande volume de munições, oito veículos de luxo, documentos, cheques e dinheiro em espécie.

Conforme a polícia, os suspeitos respondem pelos crimes de agiotagem, extorsão, organização criminosa armada e lavagem de dinheiro.

articles.title: 'Saying no to sex once should have been enough'
articles.summary: Artist Magdalena Boryn has created an exhibition to raise awareness about consent.
articles.body:
An artist who says she was raped by someone she knew when he pressured her into sex is hosting an exhibition to spark open conversations around consent.

It took Magdalena Boryn five years of blaming herself before someone pointed out that being coerced into sex could still constitute rape.

She has since channelled her "healing" into a series of paintings featuring animals, on display at the Mazi Project in Bedminster, Bristol, from 19-20 September.

Boryn said she hoped "by reducing the taboo around experiences of sexual violence we can open a broader dialogue of how they can be prevented", adding saying "no" once should have been enough.

Boryn now uses her work to advocate for "enthusiastic consent", where both partners seek eager interest, body language cues, and verbal confirmation.

"I hope that the artwork will allow people who have never experienced sexual violence themselves, a glimpse into the damage it causes internally," she said.

"I also hope it motivates everyone to be more mindful of asking for consent, and to never assume that it's implied.

"After years of processing, the exhibition feels like the final moment of letting go of the shame and pain I experienced."

Defibrillator installed after fatal cardiac arrest

Powerlifter who had eating disorder now wants to be strong

What students wish they knew before university

Under the Sexual Offences Act 2003, a person consents only if they agree by choice and have the freedom and capacity to make that choice, and when considering whether a belief in consent was reasonable, a court must look at all the circumstances, including any steps taken to ascertain whether the other person consented.

An Avon and Somerset Police spokesperson said in some circumstances, coercion, intimidation or other forms of pressure can undermine a person's freedom to choose, meaning consent may not be legally valid.

The artist, professionally known as Patterned Frog, told the BBC she started the series as a way of processing her emotions after being raped.

The collection features innocent frogs, the artist's favourite animal since childhood, interacting with "evil" slugs or missing their arms to symbolise a lack of control.

"I've always struggled with putting how I'm feeling into words," she explained.

"But once those feelings are on a canvas, I can explain what the different elements of a painting mean, and that way, I find the words for my emotions.

"There was a lot of comfort in looking at a canvas and seeing that, in a way, it also felt what I was feeling."

Boryn says she hopes the exhibit will encourage people to talk more openly about sexual violence by expressing the topic in a way that feels "more comfortable".

The weekend will also include workshops, drop-in craft activities a reading corner and information resources, including a stand for YUNO sexual health clinic.

articles.title: Better broadband for 11,500 rural homes and businesses
articles.summary: Premises in Dorset and south Somerset can now access gigabit-capable broadband.
articles.body:
Thousands of people in rural areas have been connected to faster broadband through a government-backed rollout.

More than 11,500 premises in Dorset and south Somerset can now access gigabit-capable broadband under Project Gigabit, a scheme to improve connectivity in areas that would otherwise miss out.

The first communities to benefit with provider Wessex Internet include Beaminster South and Salwayash in Dorset, as well as Aller and Dinnington in Somerset.

The project is backed by up to £39m of government funding and is expected to reach nearly 25,000 homes and businesses.

The government said the upgrades would help people working from home, running businesses, accessing online services, completing schoolwork and staying connected with family and friends.

UK Telecoms Minister Ian Murray said: "Better broadband means more than being connected to the internet. It means being connected to opportunity.

"It gives people, wherever they live, the reliable connection they need to start and grow a business from home, access education, and stay in touch with friends, family and loved ones.

"Project Gigabit is about investing in communities that risk being left behind and ensuring they have the same opportunities as everyone else."

articles.title: Hyrox apologises for allowing race to continue after athlete soils herself
articles.summary: Some raised concerns around hygiene while others praised the competitor's resolve to finish the race and push through adversity.
articles.body:
International athletics brand Hyrox has issued an apology after it came under fire for allowing an athlete to complete a race in Beijing despite soiling herself midway through the event.

Footage of the woman competing in the indoor fitness competition raised concerns around hygiene and questions over why race organisers allowed her to continue.

After a wave of criticism, Hyrox Co-founder Moritz Fürste apologised to all those affected "directly or indirectly" by the incident and said the brand is working to make immediate rule changes.

However, one expert told the BBC that allowing the athlete to continue could represent an attitude within the company that places sporting results over important factors.

'I spent £2,000 on one event': Why Gen Z is obsessed with Hyrox

How Hyrox became the latest sporting craze

In a statement posted to Instagram , Fürste said Hyrox "did not handle the situation like we should have".

He accepted responsibility for failing to foresee the incident and committed to "improving event processes" to "prevent situations like this from happening again".

Earlier, Hyrox said anyone sending abuse or threats of violence towards the athlete would be banned from any future events after her identity was shared online.

"There is no place in our community for threats of violence or encouragement to harm an athlete," Hyrox said in an earlier statement on Monday.

"Any person identified as engaging in this behaviour – whether through comments, direct messages or social media – will be permanently banned from all Hyrox events," it said.

Delving into how the incident played out, the German sports brand insisted it had "clear biocontaminant and medical procedures" in place.

It said "an unforeseen situation arose" during which protocols became blurred, "creating ambiguity in how they were applied and understood".

Following Saturday's event some participants had demanded an apology and a refund, arguing that they were forced to come into contact with contaminated equipment, Chinese media reported.

Joe Ho, who took part in the Hyrox Beijing competition over the weekend, criticised its response to the issue and called on the organisation to "take responsibility when its own procedures fail".

"If the organisation accepts that something went wrong, why not offer affected participants refunds, credits, or some meaningful form of compensation?" he wrote.

Anthony Huang, associate professor in the Department of Sport Information and Communication at the National Taiwan University of Sport, told BBC Chinese that incidents such as these could reflect a "results-driven attitude" within the rapidly growing sports brand.

"The idea that 'a win is a win' represents a results-driven view of competition, but a mature sporting culture can't just ask whether you won - it also has to ask how you won," he said.

He added the incident raises questions over Hyrox's business model and whether commercialisation may be outpacing its ability to manage the sport.

In each Hyrox race, participants alternate between running a kilometre and doing fitness exercises, including a sled push, burpee jumps, indoor rowing, and lunges while carrying a sandbag.

The competition has exploded in popularity since it was founded in 2017 in Hamburg, Germany, and is now held across the world. The sport debuted in mainland China in late 2024.

Some have questioned why those officiating the competition in Beijing last weekend did not intervene when the athlete soiled herself, given that Hyrox penalises acts including "spitting, nostril clearing, littering, and water abuse".

Others in the fitness community have pointed out that this is not unheard of for endurance athletes.

In 2005, British marathoner Paula Radcliffe famously stopped at the 22-mile mark during the London Marathon to relieve herself by the side of the road in full view of cameras and then went on to win the race.

Speaking to the BBC at the time , Radcliffe called the incident an "embarrassing necessity" and said: "When I'm racing I'm totally focused on winning the race and running as fast as possible".

Earlier this year, Chinese marathoner Li Meizhen made headlines after crossing the finish line at the Hengshui Lake Marathon with menstrual blood on her legs.

Hyrox has expanded rapidly across China, with gyms across the country cashing in on the craze. More than 500 affiliated gyms are offering Hyrox specific training, according to the state's Xinhua news agency.

The recent Beijing race faced such fierce demand that the organisers added an extra day, turning it into a four-day event to make space for even more competitors.

Additional reporting by Laura Bicker in Beijing.

articles.title: Police had councillor's fingerprints on hate mail but dropped case
articles.summary: Gerard Woodhouse's fingerprints were found on an offensive letter before he targeted another victim.
articles.body:
Police had fingerprint evidence linking a high-profile councillor to a poison pen letter up to 12 months before he went on to target another politician in a "persistent and wicked" hate mail campaign.

Well-known Liverpool anti-poverty campaigner Gerard Woodhouse, 63, was given a community order last year for harassing ex-Lord Mayor Christine Banks – who he had known for 50 years – with anonymous letters and cards in the post between 2023 and 2025.

But the BBC has learned that although an investigation that pre-dated his hate campaign against Labour colleague Banks yielded fingerprint evidence from a letter sent to a housing association boss, the inquiry was stood down because officers were "unable to establish contact" with the alleged victim after she left her job.

Despite reopening the case earlier this year, police have now had to drop it because the time limit for prosecuting harassment allegations has expired.

The alleged victim, Julie Fadden, 65, said if Woodhouse had been dealt with he might have been stopped before he began harassing Banks and other suspected victims.

Merseyside Police did not respond to the BBC's questions about whether it had done enough to contact Fadden during the 2022 investigation.

Woodhouse became a councillor in 2010, and served as its older people's champion and achieved a national spotlight with his anti-poverty campaigning.

After being de-selected by Labour in 2022, he bombarded Banks with more than 100 offensive cards and letters until his fingerprints were found on one in summer 2025.

He was arrested and pleaded guilty to harassing Banks, who he claimed to have become fixated on as a result of internal Labour Party fall-outs while suffering from severe mental health problems.

But a BBC investigation at the time found evidence to suggest several other people had also received offensive, anonymous letters from him while he was a serving councillor – claims he has never commented upon.

And the BBC has since learned that in 2022 the force received a complaint from Fadden, after a card arrived at the housing association she worked at. It suggested her "time was coming", and included the phrase "tick-tock, tick-tock".

Fadden – who is now a Liverpool Labour councillor herself - said: "That could have meant anything. It could have meant I was losing my job, but it could have meant that someone was going to be harmed."

She reported the letters to the police and they took away the original hard copies.

She did not suspect Woodhouse at the time, and only came to suspect it might have been him after seeing a BBC investigation into the ex-County ward councillor.

It featured handwriting from letters received by other Labour members, which Fadden recognised as the writing on the cards she had received.

She said the pieces then fell into place, remembering that Woodhouse had once sent a text message about her to a former employee of the housing association.

"I had done an abseil down the side of the CN Tower in Toronto to raise money for the charity Crisis, and there was a photo of me doing it on the internet.

"He sent a text message saying that they should have 'cut the rope'. The phone had previously been used by a member of staff he knew who had left, and it had been given to the finance director. So they received the message and brought it to me."

She said she now believed Woodhouse – who was a councillor at the time but was de-selected by Labour in 2022 - may have harboured a grudge because the housing association had withdrawn funding from one of his community projects.

Merseyside Police reopened its investigation in February. Woodhouse was later arrested and questioned.

But Fadden has since learned Merseyside Police will not be taking any further action.

In a letter from a Merseyside Police detective constable, she was told: "At the time of the incident a number of other offences [besides malicious communications] could have been considered and were maybe more suitable for this incident, including harassment.

"However, as harassment is a summary only offence then it carries a statute of limitations of six months so would have expired back in June 2022.

"This is why the matter was progressed with malicious communications as it is the best suited offence available, as it does not carry a statute of limitations."

However, he said while the letters were "offensive in nature", the "Police Decision Maker does not believe that they go beyond the limits of what is tolerable in society, aiming to shock, insult or degrade the victim".

Fadden said she was disappointed that the opportunity to prosecute Woodhouse had been missed.

"They said they didn't know how to contact me [when I left my job], but they had my phone number.

"When I went back to them, they told me they'd found a fingerprint on one of the letters."

She added that she "knew the police have got a hard job, and they've not got the resources they need", but that "if they had done what they needed to four years ago", then Woodhouse's campaign against Banks may have been avoided.

A spokesman for Merseyside Police said its initial 2022 investigation was "initially limited due to evidential constraints".

They added: "In September 2022, fingerprint analysis confirmed identification of a suspect and efforts were made to obtain a further statement from a victim in order to progress the investigation and consider further action.

"But we were unable to establish contact with her at that time and the investigations remained closed."

The spokesman said that as the statute of limitations for a harassment case had expired, a malicious communications case was considered in 2025 "when the victim made contact".

"However, the evidential threshold was not met for the alternate offence," they added.

articles.title: Reintroduction of butterflies to Rockingham Forest set to expand
articles.summary: A charity says it has been given £150,000 to expand the project in the next three years.
articles.body:
Conservationists who have helped reintroduce a butterfly back into England have been awarded £150,000 to expand the project over the next three years.

In total, 46 Chequered Skippers were released into Rockingham Forest close to Corby, Northamptonshire, in May, using a donor population from Belgium.

The funding has been given to the Butterfly Conservation charity from Natural England's Species Recovery Programme with the hope the species will be reintroduced to Peterborough.

Dr Jamie Wildman, based in Kettering, and from the charity, said the money would go towards "self-sufficiency of the reintroduced population, to ensure these beautiful insects can thrive in England once again".

The charity said the Chequered Skipper went extinct in England following a sudden decline in 1976 , believed to have been caused by changing woodland management in the species' Rockingham Forest heartland.

It said the coniferisation of the ancient woodlands initially led to more open conditions and the species thrived, but as the conifers grew the population disappeared.

Work to reintroduce different butterflies back to the area has been ongoing for the past 10 years.

Its former stronghold was Castor Hanglands , in woodland to the west of Peterborough, where it had been recorded for over 120 years.

The new project hopes it will be reintroduced in the area.

To catch some new Chequered Skippers, Wildman and two other officers from Butterfly Conservation, along with 20 helpers from the Belgian Research Institute for Nature and Forest, trekked through the Fagne landscape.

Those that were caught were marked with a red felt-tip pen, and 44 females and two males were brought back to the UK and released into Fineshade Wood, where they all took flight.

Karl Ivens, wildlife manager at Forestry England, said: "The return of the Chequered Skipper to Rockingham Forest is a fantastic conservation success story.

"It shows what can be achieved when expert partners, dedicated volunteers and long-term habitat management come together.

"We're incredibly proud to be helping create the conditions for this beautiful butterfly to thrive once again in Fineshade Wood, which we look after."

articles.title: Indonesia intensifies search for 129 people missing after ship capsizes
articles.summary: Officials say more than 600 rescuers battle stormy seas in search for missing people.
articles.body:
Hundreds of rescuers including the coastguard have joined the search for 129 people missing after an Indonesian passenger ship capsized in the Java Sea, authorities said Monday.

The National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas) said crews had rescued 108 people and that at least six others had died after the ferry capsized on Sunday.

The Virgo Transport 8 ship was carrying 243 people from Surabaya on the Indonesian island of Java to Banjarmasin, a port city on Borneo, when it lost contact with its operator during poor weather conditions, according to Basarnas.

“We have continued the search for the missing since early in the morning [Monday]. We are deploying 622 personnel and around 12 ships,” I Putu Sudayana, head of the Banjarmasin rescue agency, told the news service Reuters.

Choppy waters with high waves and strong winds were impeding the search on Monday, Mohammad Syafii, head of the national rescue agency, said.

“We would also deploy personnel with underwater rescue skills but the current conditions do not allow us to,” he said.

The capsized boat is about 80 nautical miles (equivalent to about 150km) from the command centre at Trisakti Port in Banjarmasin, Arianto Ardi, another official at the rescue agency, told Reuters.

“The conditions there are quite windy, ⁠making it difficult for the vessel to dock,” he said.

In a video released by the rescue agency, a large red-and-black ship lies capsized and partially submerged in choppy blue water, with its red-painted underside visible above the surface.

Two small boats, each carrying people, were seen floating near the capsized ship amid rough water.

On Sunday, Edy Prakoso, another official at the national rescue agency, said the ship leaned heavily to one side after strong waves hit its starboard side.

A passing helicopter reported the vessel had capsized, Transport Minister Dudy Purwagandhi said on Sunday, with the cause still being investigated.

He said the boat had the capacity to carry 500 passengers, so it was not overloaded.

Indonesia relies on ferries across its 17,000 islands, where sea travel is cheaper and more accessible than flying, and there have been numerous accidents.

In separate incidents last month, five people died when a ferry caught fire off Madura Island, and one person died in a fire on a ferry travelling from the tourist island of Bali.

articles.title: Animated map shows spread of illegal Israeli settlements across Palestine
articles.summary: Some 750,000 settlers live across more than 500 illegal settlements and outposts, as Israeli pogroms hit record highs.
articles.body:
Israeli settlements are Jewish-only communities built illegally on Palestinian land in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem.

These settlements often look like ordinary suburbs: uniform townhouses, red-tiled roofs, and neat lawns, perched atop hills that give them a commanding view of the Palestinian towns and villages carved up to make room for them.

In this visual explainer, Al Jazeera maps the spread of illegal Israeli settlements and outposts, and the settler pogroms accompanying them, now at their highest levels on record.

Settlements predate the creation of Israel in 1948, but their number and scale expanded dramatically after Israel occupied the West Bank and East Jerusalem in 1967.

Over the past six decades, the settlement network has grown from scattered hilltop outposts into a sprawling system of settlements, roads and highways binding them to each other and to Israel.

According to Peace Now, an Israeli anti-settlement watchdog, there are at least 148 illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank and 15 in occupied East Jerusalem, 163 in total, now home to some 750,000 Israelis, roughly 10 percent of the country’s Jewish population.

The animation below tracks the founding of each settlement and outpost, along with their growing populations. In 2025 alone, nearly 28,000 housing units were advanced within existing settlements in the occupied West Bank, far more growth than new settlements or outposts added on their own.

By 2024, these 163 illegal settlements were home to 744,700 Israeli settlers: 511,100 in the West Bank and 233,600 in East Jerusalem, alongside a record number of illegal outposts, now more than 400, that are not officially counted but are often absorbed into recognised settlements over time, making a true tally difficult to pin down.

Settlements are illegal under international law as they violate the Fourth Geneva Convention, which bans an occupying power from transferring its population to the area it occupies.

The United Nations Security Council, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) and the International Committee of the Red Cross, among others, have affirmed this position, most recently in the ICJ’s July 2024 advisory opinion.

Under Israeli law, settlements are legally sanctioned, planned, funded and built with direct government approval, ranging from small rural communities to large towns like Ariel and Maale Adumim.

Outposts are different. They are smaller communities built without formal authorisation, though many are later legalised or absorbed into existing settlements.

How settlements carve up Palestinian land

Some Israeli settlements have grown into sizable urban communities, complete with their own mayors, schools, shopping malls, medical centres and even universities.

Modi’in Illit is the largest, with 89,301 residents, followed by Beitar Illit with 70,251 and Pisgat Ze’ev with 48,419.

Like most settlements, they are linked by a dense network of roads built exclusively for settlers, many of them bypass roads that cut through Palestinian land, fragmenting communities and, backed by checkpoints and roadblocks, restricting the movement of Palestinians who live alongside them.

Nowhere is this clearer than E1, an area east of Jerusalem planned for the expansion of Maale Adumim, which would sever East Jerusalem from the rest of the West Bank and further fragment Palestinian territorial continuity.

In August 2025, Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich approved more than 3,000 homes in the E1 settlement project, a plan frozen for decades under international pressure, declaring the move would “bury the idea of a Palestinian state”.

The decision drew global condemnation, including from nearly 30 governments and the European Commission, who called it “unacceptable and a violation of international law”.

Israeli settlers can be broadly divided into two types.

The first are largely drawn by economics: cheaper rents, subsidised mortgages, discounted land and government incentives that make housing in the illegal settlements far more affordable than in Israel proper.

The second are religious-nationalists, who believe the land was promised to them by God. This group includes the “hilltop youth”, known for establishing outposts and attacking Palestinian communities, often with the Israeli military standing by or backing them, as in the weeks-long siege of Qusra , which began in August and continues under military enforcement today.

Experts and UN officials increasingly describe these attacks as pogroms , organised, often state-backed violence against a targeted minority, a term Israeli military officers themselves have used after past incidents such as the 2023 attack on Huwara.

According to data from the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), settler attacks resulting in casualties and/or property damage have risen sharply, particularly since October 7, 2023.

In 2025, 1,836 such attacks were recorded, more than double the 852 recorded in 2022, an average of about five attacks a day.

Since October 7, 2023, 5,131 attacks have been recorded in total. The increase has continued into 2026, with 1,418 attacks recorded between January and July, though the year is not yet complete.

The violence and the creation of new outposts are two different aspects of settlement activity, but together they show how illegal settlement expansion is occurring not only through established communities and government planning, but also through new activity on the ground.

articles.title: US Kennedy Center faces bankruptcy, Washington Post reports
articles.summary: Board of trustees recommends that the main building be closed immediately due to costs, US newspaper reports.
articles.body:
The John F Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, DC, is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close as soon as Tuesday, The Washington Post has reported.

According to the report in the United States newspaper on Sunday, the institution’s board of trustees, of which President Donald Trump is the chairman, has argued that putting the president’s name on the facade could be the only way to avoid imminent and “certain fiscal collapse”.

The trustees also say the institution will not be able to pay employees or meet maintenance costs within a few weeks.

The assessment was set out in a 57-page report before a special meeting on Tuesday, when the Trump-led board is expected to consider the two main issues affecting the performing arts centre: A financial crisis and a physical one, as the building needs renovation.

The Post reported that board members are recommending that the main building be closed immediately due to costs.

The ⁠Post also said Trump ⁠would help the Kennedy Center if his involvement is acknowledged. The trustees’ report represents “a remarkable new phase in Trump’s takeover of the Kennedy ⁠Center, which has been engulfed by financial turmoil, leadership upheaval and litigation ⁠since he installed himself as chairman ⁠last year”, the paper said.

The Kennedy Center was named in honour of the late US president who championed civil rights before he was assassinated in 1963.

Trump placed himself as chairman of the Kennedy Centre shortly after beginning his second term last year, and in December his hand-picked board voted to rename it the “Trump-Kennedy” Centre, a move later blocked in court.

In response to Trump’s takeover, a host of artists have cancelled concerts, with US media reporting that ticket sales had fallen to their lowest levels since the COVID-19 pandemic.

The Post reported that the centre was expected to collect about $124m of the projected $220m in revenue that it had budgeted, “leaving a roughly $23 million deficit even after substantial spending cuts” this past fiscal year.

It added that a spokesperson for the centre blamed the problems on “financial mismanagement by previous leadership” and said Trump’s name had attracted new donors.

articles.title: Bali police investigate after Australian man and children found dead in home
articles.summary: Police were called after the man's wife became concerned and asked neighbours to check on her family.
articles.body:
Police in Bali are investigating after the bodies of an Australian man and his two children were found dead in their bungalow in a popular tourist area.

Damien John Shaw, 56, and his two children, a boy aged six and a girl aged four, were found dead in their home in Kuta on Sunday.

Police said neighbours had checked in on the family after a call from the man's wife, who had become concerned after a phone call with her husband. She was not in Bali at the time.

Australian media reported that police were treating the case as a suspected murder-suicide. Police told the BBC they had not yet determined the cause or manner of death and that further examinations would be carried out.

Police said the man's wife had called a neighbour after hearing one of her children crying while on the phone to her husband. She was subsequently unable to contact him again.

His wife had reportedly travelled to the capital Jakarta in the previous days.

Police said that the neighbour, accompanied by other local residents, had then forced their way into the property after there was no response to their knocks. The three victims were discovered inside.

Police said Shaw was originally from Fremantle in Western Australia. Roger Cook, the state's premier, described the news as a "very confronting situation".

"This is a very sad situation; our hearts go out to everyone involved. We hope we can get to the bottom of what's gone on as soon as possible," he added.

articles.title: CFDA boss apologizes for acting ‘inappropriately’ against protesters at New York Fashion Week show
articles.summary: The CEO of the Council of Fashion Designers of America appeared to physically restrain activists who interrupted a COS runway show on Sunday.
articles.body: The head of American fashion’s leading trade association has apologized for reacting “inappropriately” after an altercation with animal rights protesters at a runway show. The CEO and president of the Council of Fashion Designers of America (CFDA), Steven Kolb, was filmed appearing to physically restrain two activists who interrupted a New York Fashion Week presentation on Sunday. Videos show Kolb grabbing the protestors, snatching at their printed signs and covering their mouths with his hands as they shouted slogans including “get wool off the runway now.” He was also filmed wrapping his leg around one of the activists, whom he appeared to pin to the floor as models continued walking the runway at Swedish brand COS’s Fall-Winter 2026 show. Posting on Instagram Stories shortly after the incident, Kolb wrote: “I reacted inappropriately to an incident at a show earlier today. It wasn’t my place to do so. I should have let the security team handle the situation.” Neither he nor the CFDA responded to CNN’s request for further comment. In a statement, the People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) said its activists had been “assaulted” by Kolb. The group said it had targeted COS as part of an ongoing campaign to pressure the label’s parent company, H&M Group, to cease using wool in its products. In a phone interview shortly after the incident, one of the protesters, Mason Melito, told CNN he had been unaware of who Kolb was until after he was ejected from the show. Videos show Kolb appearing to push Melito into a corner and attempting to cover his mouth. “The violence the CEO of the CFDA showed toward us, in his attempt to silence us, just completely mirrors the violence inherent in the wool industry,” said the 22-year-old, describing himself as a senior campaigner with PETA. In a press release, PETA said the protesters are “filing a police report and plan to pursue criminal charges,” though Melito said they are “just considering our options right now.” He added: “What we really want to do is talk to Mr. Kolb.” Counting more than 300 designers and labels among its members, the CFDA organizes New York Fashion Week, which concludes Tuesday, and hosts an annual awards ceremony dubbed the “Oscars of Fashion.” Kolb has served as the organization’s CEO since 2011. Last December, the CFDA announced that it was banning animal fur at New York Fashion Week, although this does not include wool or other products derived from shorn animal hairs. The move was, at the time, welcomed by PETA, which famously staged a naked protest at Oscar de la Renta’s New York Fashion Week runway show in 1991 as part of its long-running “I’d rather go naked” campaign. PETA has alleged that H&M Group is linked to a South African wool facility that it secretly filmed treating sheep cruelly. The nonprofit group says the facility has been certified by Nativa, an ethical fiber industry standard used by the Swedish retail giant. A PETA spokesperson also alleged that the facility sells wool to an auction house used by H&M Group. The investigation did not find evidence explicitly linking the farm to the H&M Group’s products. Neither H&M Group nor Nativa’s parent company, Chargeurs, immediately responded to CNN’s request for comment. H&M Group has shared its goal of ensuring 100% of all wool used will come from certified responsible wool farms, recycled sources or replaced with non-animal fibers by 2026. COS has become a regular fixture at New York Fashion Week since debuting in 2022. Celebrities including Lupita Nyong’o, Sharon Stone, John Boyega and Michelle Williams attended at the WSA Building in downtown Manhattan for this season’s show, which continued despite the interruption.

articles.title: North Korea says its recent live-fire drill demonstrated ‘huge destructive power’
articles.summary: North Korea said Monday it conducted a joint live-fire drill involving missiles, artillery and drones that it claimed demonstrated “huge destructive power.”
articles.body: SEOUL, South Korea — North Korea said Monday that it had conducted a joint live-fire drill involving missiles, artillery and drones that it claimed demonstrated “huge destructive power.” The test included firing different types of weapons simultaneously, most likely aiming at developing the ability to overwhelm South Korean and U.S. air defenses. Experts say North Korea is not slowing its testing activities even after U.S. President Donald Trump recently scaled back a military exercise with South Korea in an apparent effort to revive diplomacy with leader Kim Jong Un. The North’s official Korean Central News Agency said Saturday’s drill was meant to practice the operations of an integrated weapons control system. South Korea’s military earlier said it detected short-range ballistic missile launches from North Korea’s eastern coastal Wonsan area on Saturday morning. After observing the firing drill, North Korean Marshal Pak Jong Chon said the drill would “improve the level of specialization to bring down the enemy’s armed forces organizationally and structurally once an order is issued.” He added that the weapons systems mobilized demonstrated “the huge destructive power of concentrated fire,” according to KCNA. It is extremely difficult to independently verify North Korean claims on its weapons tests. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff said several missiles fired Saturday each flew about 155 miles toward North Korea’s eastern waters. The flight distances signal that the weapons are designed to strike targets in South Korea, including U.S. military bases. The firing drill, which included North Korea’s first public ballistic missile launches in about three weeks, came a day after the United States, South Korea and Japan wrapped up a trilateral military exercise that North Korea views as a provocation. In August, Trump ordered the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” a major bilateral military exercise with South Korea, citing what he called a good relationship with Kim. But North Korea rebuffed Trump’s overture, saying that shortening the drill didn’t change its “provocative, aggressive nature.” The Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise eventually ended six days earlier than originally scheduled. Buoyed by his advancing nuclear arsenal and deepened ties with Russia and China, experts say Kim most likely thinks he has greater leverage in possible diplomacy with the U.S. than when he first met Trump in 2018-2019. Kim said earlier this year that he could return to talks if the U.S. drops its “hostile policy” against his country and respects what he calls the North’s status as a nuclear state.

articles.title: Nepal tunnel survivor finds solace in village homecoming
articles.summary: After nine days trapped in a hydropower tunnel and a week of hospital care following his dramatic rescue, Sanjay Sah, a rare survivor of last month’s devastating glacier collapse in Nepal, finally returned to his village and family on Sunday.
articles.body: TILATHI KOILADI, Nepal — After nine days trapped in a hydropower tunnel and a week of hospital care following his dramatic rescue, Sanjay Sah, a rare survivor of last month’s devastating glacier collapse in Nepal, finally returned to his village and family on Sunday. It was a homecoming marked by relief and joy but also grief. “I was trapped in the tunnel ... I felt trapped in the hospital room too. I finally feel free here in my village,” Sah, 30, said after arriving in Tilathi Koiladi, near the border with India. At least 1,386 people have died and 5,130 are still missing across Nepal weeks after a Himalayan glacier collapsed near the Chinese border, unleashing a wall of mud and water that crashed through mountain valleys and destroyed everything in its path. Around 900 power station workers remain missing. Sah, a mechanical foreman at the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Station, was one of just three pulled from debris-buried tunnels extending deep under the mountains. He survived in the darkness, drinking floodwater and seepage from the mountain rock until rescue workers finally reached him. Sah left the hospital in the capital, Kathmandu, on Friday and the next day boarded a bus for an overnight journey home. Around 60 people, mostly women, awaited his arrival in Tilathi Koiladi on Sunday. Family members, including his parents, uncle, wife and daughter, performed a traditional welcome ceremony, washing his feet as part of a cleansing ritual. After his mother dabbed a pink vermilion tika on his forehead, Sah bowed. They embraced and then broke down in tears. “My son!” his mother cried, holding him tightly and kissing him on the cheek. Women who had gathered to witness the reunion used their colorful saris to wipe the tears from their eyes. Many in Tilathi Koiladi are still awaiting word of the fate of family members who had been working at hydropower stations hit by the flooding. “There are more people from my village still missing after the flood,” Sah told Reuters. One family, he said, phoned him while he was still in the hospital to ask if he had seen or heard from a missing relative who had been working at a different power station. He had to tell them he had not. At home among family, Sah said he was ready to put his ordeal behind him. “I will stay in my village for some time now. I want to meet all my people,” he said. “But if I am called back to duty, I will go.”

articles.title: China has a chokehold on your medicine cabinet. It’s a national security threat
articles.summary: The United States produces just 3% of active pharmaceutical ingredients while China controls 45%, creating a dangerous drug supply chain crisis.
articles.body: The United States produces roughly 3% of the active pharmaceutical ingredients in the world. Meanwhile, China produces a whopping 45%. A Johns Hopkins study found that China supplies more than 60% of the essential components American manufacturers need for antibiotics. That’s not just a trade imbalance, it is surrendering sovereignty. The health of our military, our leaders, our children and our neighbors is beholden to an adversary who could weaponize not just the availability of and access to essential medications but the safety of those very products. ROBERT F KENNEDY JR: THE FUTURE OF MEDICINE SHOULD BE BUILT IN AMERICA We didn’t get here by accident. Decades of offshoring gutted the American industrial base and shipped critical manufacturing jobs overseas. As recently as 1981, the United States produced 25% of the world’s pharmaceutical ingredients. Today, China controls nearly half the global market. A nation that cannot make its own antibiotics and cannot stop adversary-sourced chemicals from crossing its border does not fully govern itself. The Council on Foreign Relations called this what it is: a pharma choke point. The dependence is structural, deep and spreading from generics into advanced biologics. CORPORATE AMERICA'S CHINA ADDICTION HAS BECOME A NATIONAL SECURITY THREAT Beijing has already shown it will weaponize supply chains. It did so with rare earths, semiconductor inputs and defense-critical metals. Why would we believe the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) would treat medicine any differently in a crisis when it has the capacity to poison an entire people? The same chemical networks that feed Chinese precursors into American pharmacies also feed the fentanyl pipeline through Mexico. Research from the University of Virginia’s National Security Data and Policy Institute describes Chinese suppliers and Mexican cartels as a singular adaptive supply chain: precursors bought cheaply online, air-shipped in bulk, converted into pills, and pushed across the border. EXPERT WARNS CHINA ALREADY WAGING ‘UNRESTRICTED WARFARE’ AGAINST US THROUGH FENTANYL, ESPIONAGE AND SABOTAGE A few thousand dollars of chemicals can buy millions of doses. The wreckage in Midwestern towns is not a mystery. It is the real-life effect of a Chinese chemical distribution system operating behind a cartel front. Congress has rightly begun to respond. The BIOSECURE Act, signed into law in December 2025, restricts federal procurement involving biotechnology products from designated companies tied to foreign adversaries. President Donald Trump also took executive action on tariffs targeting the synthetic opioid supply chain. Those steps matter. But they don’t build manufacturing plants. EXCLUSIVE: FENTANYL DEATHS PLUNGE 22% AS TRUMP WHITE HOUSE TOUTS CRACKDOWN ON DEADLY DRUG CRISIS Legislation alone does not build a factory, bring jobs back and secure our nation. To effectively pry China’s grip off our supply chain, we must invest heavily in domestic producers. We need to build the manufacturing facilities here at home. Take my home state of Ohio: the Buckeye State shows this model works. The state is already becoming a center of American semiconductor manufacturing by combining investment, infrastructure and a skilled workforce. It has the same heritage to become a national hub for pharmaceutical production. CNBC recently ranked Ohio No. 1 in the country for both business and infrastructure. Incentivize American companies to build advanced manufacturing in the Midwest and you do two things at once: create secure work and close a defense vulnerability. The health of our military, our leaders, our children and our neighbors is beholden to an adversary who could weaponize not just the availability of and access to essential medications but the safety of those very products. SEN KEVIN CRAMER: CHINA BUILDS FOR WAR WHILE AMERICA WAITS ON PERMITS The choice is not complicated. Invest now in American pharmaceutical capacity or pay an unimaginable price later when Beijing turns the American medicine supply into a weapon. The military is not ready as long as battlefield antibiotics are manufactured in a country we may one day fight. And the American people are not safe as long as their medicine cabinet depends on the goodwill of an adversary. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Build the plants. Bring the work home.
